title: Change a company name (NM01)
text:
It costs £30 to file a change of name using the paper form. Make your cheque payable to ‘Companies House’.

 File online

 You can  use the Companies House online service  to file changes of name by special resolution only.

 It costs £20 to file a change of name online, or £85 for the same-day service.
changeNote: Removed message about delays to filings, as our filings are now being processed as normal.
